captures.heading: Absorbing Man
articleText: Black Uru FormSP1 or the chosen starting Form activates Black Uru, the default starting Form; re-entry Refines and refreshes it, a Buff ending on the Opponent, Debuff immunity or Light interrupts of Basic Attacks pause it, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and the signature ability extends Form duration.SynergyAbomination (Immortal)Hulk (Immortal)The Green Door — This synergy extends Black Uru Form duration, entered by SP1 or starting-Form selection; re-entry Refines and refreshes it, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, signature extends its duration further, and duplicate synergies do not stack.

Crit Through BlockCritical Hits can pass through Block only in Refined Black Uru, reached by re-entry, sufficient Charge consumption via MLM or a Special at maximum Charges, or SP3 restoring the most recent Form Refined; a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and signature extends Form duration.
CrueltyPassive SP3 grants indefinite Cruelty increasing Critical Damage Rating, with additional Cruelty if a Refined Form is already active, subject to a stack cap.
Gain PowerBlocking a hit reduces the Opponent's Ability Power Rate and transfers the denied Power to Absorbing Man until he stops blocking.

Magma FormSP2 or the chosen starting Form activates Magma; re-entry Refines and refreshes it, a Buff ending on the Opponent, Debuff immunity or Light interrupts of Basic Attacks pause it, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and the signature ability extends Form duration.SynergyAbomination (Immortal)Hulk (Immortal)The Green Door — This synergy extends Magma Form duration, entered by SP2 or starting-Form selection; re-entry Refines and refreshes it, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, signature extends its duration further, and duplicate synergies do not stack.

Morph ChargeActivating a Special after the preceding attack's opening hit lands grants Morph Charges and carries that attack's bonus Critical Rating into the Special; the qualifying preceding attack and its Stun condition are unspecified.Refreshing or changing Forms grants Morph Charges based on the previous Form's remaining duration; sufficient Charges are consumed by MLM or a Special at maximum Charges to Refine the current Form and inflict temporary Vulnerability Passives.Being immune to an Armor Break or Armor Shattered Debuff grants Morph Charges; sufficient Charges are consumed by MLM or a Special at maximum Charges to Refine the current Form and inflict temporary Vulnerability Passives.

PauseOmni-Morph Forms — Interrupting the Opponent's Basic Attack with a Light Attack temporarily pauses the current Form and inflicts a temporary Vulnerability Passive, subject to a stack cap.Omni-Morph Forms — A Buff ending on the Opponent or Absorbing Man being immune to a Debuff temporarily pauses his current Form.SP3 activates the most recent Form in its Refined state and pauses it, granting Critical Rating only during that pause.SynergyBlack TarantulaPuñO Cerrado — Punishing a Special Attack with a Light Attack temporarily pauses Omni-Morph Forms through this synergy; duplicate synergies do not stack.
Pre-Fight AbilityChoose the starting Form in the Pre-Fight Menu, with Black Uru as the default; the choice persists until changed.

Refined Black Uru FormRe-enter Black Uru or consume sufficient Charges via MLM or a Special at maximum Charges to Refine it; SP3 restores the most recent Form Refined, starting-Form selection alone does not Refine, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and signature extends Form duration.SynergyAbomination (Immortal)Hulk (Immortal)The Green Door — This synergy extends Refined Black Uru duration, reached by re-entry or sufficient Charges via MLM or a Special at maximum Charges; SP3 restores the most recent Form Refined, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, signature extends duration further, and duplicate synergies do not stack.

Refined Magma FormRe-enter Magma or consume sufficient Charges via MLM or a Special at maximum Charges to Refine it; SP3 restores the most recent Form Refined, starting-Form selection alone does not Refine, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and signature extends Form duration.SynergyAbomination (Immortal)Hulk (Immortal)The Green Door — This synergy extends Refined Magma duration, reached by re-entry or sufficient Charges via MLM or a Special at maximum Charges; SP3 restores the most recent Form Refined, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, signature extends duration further, and duplicate synergies do not stack.

RegenerationPassive Signature ability: consuming Morph Charges grants temporary, non-stacking Regeneration based on missing Health, also triggered by entering or refreshing a Form as a Defender; True Damage hits pause personal Regeneration, and early Form deactivation from a Heavy hit during Special recovery removes it.

UnblockablePassive Molecular Duplication - Always Active — Special Attacks are Unblockable in a Refined Form, reached by re-entering the active Form, consuming sufficient Charges with MLM or a Special at maximum Charges, or SP3 restoring the most recent Form Refined; a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and signature extends Form duration.
Ability Power Rate ReductionBlocking a hit reduces the Opponent's Ability Power Rate until Absorbing Man stops blocking.

Armor BreakSynergyThorThor (Jane Foster)Debuff The Worthy — This synergy lets the second Medium Attack inflict temporary Armor Break on the Opponent, subject to a stack cap; duplicate synergies do not stack.
AtrophyAbsorbing Man shortens the Opponent's Indestructible, Immortality, Unstoppable and Unblockable Buffs.

Burst DamageBlack Uru attacks deal Physical Damage bursts whose Ability Accuracy cannot be modified and which benefit from Critical Damage on Critical Hits; Refined bursts can trigger through Block and be Critical, while a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate the Form subject to cooldown and signature extends its duration.Magma attacks deal Energy Damage bursts whose Ability Accuracy cannot be modified and which benefit from Critical Damage on Critical Hits; Refined bursts can be Critical, while a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate the Form subject to cooldown and signature extends its duration.SynergyThe SerpentThe Main Event — For Absorbing Man as a #Cul's Worthy recipient, this synergy strengthens Black Uru Physical bursts; Refined bursts can trigger through Block and be Critical, their Ability Accuracy cannot be modified, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate the Form subject to cooldown, and duplicate synergies do not stack.For Absorbing Man as a #Cul's Worthy recipient, this synergy strengthens Magma Energy bursts; their Ability Accuracy cannot be modified, Critical Hits enhance them, Refined bursts can be Critical, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate the Form subject to cooldown, and duplicate synergies do not stack.

Energy DamageMorph Charges — In Magma or Refined Magma Form, all attacks deal Energy instead of Physical Damage; SP2 or the starting-Form choice enters Magma, re-entry refreshes it, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and signature extends Form duration.

IncineratePassive Morph Charges — Contact with the Opponent inflicts Incinerate Passives only in Refined Magma, reached by re-entering Magma, consuming sufficient Charges with MLM or a Special at maximum Charges, or SP3 restoring the most recent Form Refined; a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and signature extends Form duration.

VulnerabilityPassive A Medium-Light-Medium combo with sufficient Morph Charges, or a Special Attack at maximum Charges, consumes available Charges to Refine the current Form and inflict temporary Vulnerability Passives based on Charges spent.Passive Omni-Morph Forms — Interrupting the Opponent's Basic Attack with a Light Attack inflicts a temporary Vulnerability Passive, subject to a stack cap, and temporarily pauses the current Form.

Ability Accuracy ModificationImmunityOmni-Morph Forms — Form changes cannot fail due to Ability Accuracy Modification; this protection applies only to Form changes.Omni-Morph Forms — Absorbing Man's personal damage bursts cannot have their Ability Accuracy modified.
Armor BreakImmunityDebuff
Armor ShatterImmunityDebuff

BleedImmunityMorph Charges — Immune to Bleed only while Black Uru or Refined Black Uru is active; SP1 or the starting-Form choice enters Black Uru, re-entry refreshes it, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and the signature ability extends its duration.

ColdsnapImmunityMorph Charges — Immune to Coldsnap only in Magma or Refined Magma Form, entered through SP2 or the starting-Form choice; re-entry refreshes it, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and the signature ability extends Form duration.

DebuffsResistanceSynergyRogueduration reduction· See source conditionsHands-On Approach — This synergy shortens Non-Damaging Debuffs on Absorbing Man, excluding Stuns; duplicate synergies do not stack.Synergy values · 7★Absorbing Man: Reduce the duration of Non-Damaging Debuffs other than Stuns by 50%.

FrostbiteImmunityMorph Charges — Immune to Frostbite only while Magma or Refined Magma is active; SP2 or the starting-Form choice enters Magma, re-entry refreshes it, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and the signature ability extends its duration.

IncinerateImmunityMorph Charges — Immune to Incinerate only while Magma or Refined Magma is active; SP2 or the starting-Form choice enters Magma, re-entry refreshes it, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and the signature ability extends its duration.
PoisonImmunitySynergyAbomination (Immortal)Hulk (Immortal)The Green Door — This synergy grants Absorbing Man Poison immunity and extends Omni-Morph Form duration; duplicate synergies do not stack.

ShockImmunityMorph Charges — Immune to Shock only in Black Uru or Refined Black Uru Form, entered through SP1 or the starting-Form choice; re-entry refreshes it, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and the signature ability extends Form duration.

captures.heading: Absorbing Man
articleText: Signature AbilityAlways ActiveAbsorbing Man’s Omni-Morph Forms last 40% longer.When Absorbing Man consumes Morph Charges, he gains a non-stacking Regeneration Passive, healing 30.01% of his missing Health over 12 seconds. As a Defender, this effect also triggers whenever Absorbing Man enters or refreshes any Form.Personal Regeneration effects pause for 3 seconds when Absorbing Man is struck with True Damage and are removed when a form is deactivated early.Signature curves3 effects · Combined viewDuration Id Percent40Regen30Regen30.01Mixed units share a normalized range. Hover, tap, or focus the chart to see actual values.100%75%50%25%0%EFFECT RANGE150100150200Sig 200: Duration Id Percent 40, Regen 30, Regen 30.01Y-axis · Effect rangeActual values in legend and tooltipX-axis · Signature level

Base AbilitiesMolecular Duplication - Always ActiveA fluid molecular structure grants Absorbing Man 20% Crit Resistance and Immunity to Armor Break and Armor Shattered Debuffs, but reduces his Critical Penetration by 20% flat.Absorbing Man is no stranger to brawling with beings of otherworldly resilience. He reduces the duration of his Opponent’s Indestructible, Immortality, Unstoppable, and Unblockable Buffs by 90%.Omni-Morph FormsAbsorbing Man’s Special Attacks transform him into powerful altered Forms. He can only be in one Form at a time, and Form changes cannot fail due to Ability Accuracy Modification.Absorbing Man starts each fight in his Black Uru Form by default, but can use the Pre-Fight Menu to change this default, which persists until changed again.Being struck by a Heavy Attack while recovering from a Special Attack deactivates the current Form, which cannot be deactivated again in this way for 20 seconds.Whenever a Buff ends on the Opponent or Absorbing Man is Immune to a Debuff, the current Form pauses for 3 seconds.Interrupting an Opponent's Basic Attack with a Light Attack pauses the current Form for 6 seconds and inflicts a 485.29 potency Vulnerability Passive for 15 seconds. Max Stacks: 5.Refined FormsIf Absorbing Man would enter a Form that is already active, he instead Refines the Form, refreshing its duration and granting additional benefits.Personal bursts of damage benefit from 300% of Absorbing Man's Critical Damage Multiplier when he lands a Critical Hit and cannot have their Ability Accuracy modified.Special Attacks are Passively Unblockable.Blocking a Hit reduces the Opponent’s Ability Power Rate by 72% until Absorbing Man stops blocking. The Power denied is transferred to Absorbing Man.Morph ChargesWhen Absorbing Man refreshes or changes Forms, he gains Morph Charges equal to the remaining percentage of his previous Form’s base duration. Max 600.Whenever Absorbing Man is Immune to an Armor Break or Armor Shattered Debuff, he gains 90 Morph Charges.Performing a Medium, Light, Medium Combo with at least 150 Morph Charges, or activating a Special Attack at max charges consumes available Charges to Refine the current Form and inflict one 30 second Vulnerability Passive with 2,750 potency for every 150 Charges consumed.This attack gains 2,250 Critical Rating if the Opponent is Stunned as the first hit lands.This attack instead gains 24,749.99 Critical Rating if the Opponent is not Stunned as the first hit lands.Activating a Special Attack after the first hit lands applies this bonus Critical Rating to the entire Special and grants 30 Morph Charges.Gain Immunity to all Bleed and Shock effects and +11,000 Physical Resistance.All attacks deal a burst of 2,014.2 Physical Damage.Refined: Absorbing Man can perform Critical Hits and trigger personal bursts of damage through the Opponent’s Block.Gain Immunity to all Incinerate, Coldsnap, and Frostbite effects and +11,000 Energy Resistance.All attacks deal Energy Damage instead of Physical, as well as a burst of 2,014.2 Energy Damage.Refined: Contact with the Opponent inflicts an Incinerate Passive, dealing 3,524.85 Energy Damage over 1 second.

Special Attack 1 - Uru RushAbsorbing Man takes on the composition of his trusty ball-and-chain as he whips it forward to knock the Opponent off balance before rushing forward with a vicious shoulder check.Always ActiveOn activation, enter Black Uru Form for 0 seconds, granting the following benefits:

Special Attack 2 - Magma SpinCarl Creel absorbs the molten underbelly of the Battlerealm as he spins his ball-and-chain in a powerful hammer throw, lifting himself into the air before slamming into his Opponent in an explosion of liquid rock.Always ActiveOn activation, enter Magma Form for 0 seconds, granting the following benefits:

Special Attack 3 - Forbidden FruitTemporarily drawing on the dangerous energies of Black-ISO itself, Absorbing Man encases his Opponent in crystal before shattering them beneath his trademark wrecking ball.CrueltyGain an indefinite Cruelty Passive, increasing Critical Damage Rating by 144.74. If a Refined Form is already active, gain a second Cruelty Passive. Max Stacks: 5.Activate the most recent Form in its Refined state. Pause it for 15 seconds. While this Pause is active, Absorbing Man gains 11,000 Critical Rating.

captures.heading: AbominationImmortal
articleText: PoisonDebuff The signature ability grants indefinite self-Poisons at fight start and raises their stack cap; these Poisons increase Physical Resistance and reduce enemy Inequity potency up to a limit.Debuff SP1 grants indefinite self-Poisons, with more while Toxic Aura is active; they increase Physical Resistance and reduce enemy Inequity potency up to a limit, with a higher self-Poison cap from the signature ability.Debuff Petrify — After enough Basic Attacks land from either champion, Abomination gains indefinite self-Poison and resets the count; these Poisons increase Physical Resistance and reduce enemy Inequity potency up to a limit, with a higher self-Poison cap from the signature ability.SynergyRed SkullDebuff Immortal Rulers — This synergy lowers the Basic Attack count for indefinite self-Poison, counting hits landed by either champion and resetting on activation; self-Poisons increase Physical Resistance and reduce enemy Inequity potency up to a limit, signature raises their cap, and duplicate synergies do not stack.

Toxic AuraSP2 activates Toxic Aura, periodically consuming self-Poison to pause it and repeatedly Poisoning nearby Opponents faster with extra stacks; consumption pauses during Opponent Specials, and SP3 slows consumption until Aura expiry with a non-stacking enhancement that can be prepared before activation.
UnblockablePoison — Attacks are Unblockable when striking an Opponent suffering from Acid Burn.
ViciousSynergyBaron ZemoBuff Goo Platoon — Activating a Special Attack grants a temporary, non-stacking Vicious Buff that increases Damage Over Time Debuff potency; duplicate synergies do not stack.

Acid BurnPassive SP3 inflicts Acid Burn Passives on the Opponent, with additional Acid Burns for Toxic Aura stacks; the signature ability extends their duration.Passive Base kit — Reaching the Poison Debuff threshold on the Opponent converts those Debuffs into an Acid Burn Passive dealing damage over time; the signature ability extends its duration.SynergyKing GrootPassive Immortal Kings — This synergy strengthens Acid Burn formed by converting the Opponent's Poisons at their threshold; Acid Burn deals damage over time, the signature ability extends its duration, and duplicate synergies do not stack.Passive This synergy strengthens SP3 Acid Burn damage, with additional Acid Burns for Toxic Aura stacks; the signature ability extends their duration, and duplicate synergies do not stack.SynergyChee'IlthPassive What You Fear, You'Ll Destroy — This synergy increases damaging-effect potency, including SP3 Acid Burns with additional applications for Toxic Aura stacks; the signature ability extends their duration, and duplicate synergies do not stack.Passive This synergy increases damaging-effect potency, including Acid Burn formed by converting the Opponent's Poisons at their threshold; the signature ability extends Acid Burn duration, and duplicate synergies do not stack.
Armor BreakSynergyMan-ThingVenom The DuckDebuff Fairest Of Them All — Heavy Attacks temporarily reduce the Opponent's Armor Rating through this synergy; duplicate synergies do not stack.

Burst DamageStriking an Opponent suffering from Acid Burn deals a burst of Physical Damage.SynergyChee'IlthWhat You Fear, You'Ll Destroy — This synergy strengthens damaging effects, including the Physical Damage burst dealt when striking an Opponent suffering from Acid Burn; duplicate synergies do not stack.

EnervateSynergyAbominationDebuff Abominable Comrade — When a Poison Debuff expires or is removed from the Opponent, this synergy may inflict temporary Enervate, preventing Power gain when struck; duplicate synergies do not stack.

PetrifyDebuff Activating SP1 inflicts a temporary, non-stacking Petrify Debuff on the Opponent; the signature ability extends its duration.Debuff Conditional — Triggering Acid Burn inflicts a temporary Petrify Debuff on the Opponent; the signature ability extends its duration.

PoisonDebuff Base kit — Contact with the Opponent may inflict Poison that deals damage over time and reduces Health recovery, except while Acid Burn's recovery-reducing Poison is active; the signature ability extends Poison duration.Debuff During SP2 Toxic Aura, proximity repeatedly inflicts damaging, recovery-reducing Poison on the Opponent, faster with extra Aura stacks, except while Acid Burn's recovery-reducing Poison is active; the signature ability extends Poison duration.Debuff Conditional — While Acid Burn is active, the Opponent suffers an indefinite, non-stacking Poison that reduces Health recovery and prevents further personal Poison applications.SynergyChee'IlthDebuff What You Fear, You'Ll Destroy — This synergy increases damaging-effect potency, including contact Poison that may damage the Opponent over time and reduce recovery but cannot apply during Acid Burn's recovery-reducing Poison; signature extends Poison duration, and duplicate synergies do not stack.Debuff This synergy strengthens damaging, recovery-reducing Poison repeatedly applied near the Opponent during SP2 Toxic Aura, faster with extra Aura stacks, except during Acid Burn's recovery-reducing Poison; signature extends Poison duration, and duplicate synergies do not stack.SynergyKing GrootDebuff Immortal Kings — This synergy strengthens contact-triggered Poison, which may damage the Opponent over time and reduce Health recovery but cannot apply during Acid Burn's recovery-reducing Poison; the signature ability extends Poison duration, and duplicate synergies do not stack.Debuff This synergy strengthens damaging, recovery-reducing Poison repeatedly applied near the Opponent during SP2 Toxic Aura, faster with extra Aura stacks, except during Acid Burn's recovery-reducing Poison; signature extends Poison duration, and duplicate synergies do not stack.
WeaknessDebuff Conditional — While Abomination is Poisoned, blocking an attack inflicts temporary Weakness on the Opponent, reducing Attack Rating.

PoisonResistancedamage reduction· See source conditionsBase kit — Abomination takes reduced Poison damage and suffers a weaker Poison recovery penalty, but Poison can still be applied to him.Recorded valuesTake 100% less damage from Poison effects and the recovery reduction from Poison is 50% less effective.

articleText: Black Uru FormSP1 or the chosen starting Form activates Black Uru, the default starting Form; re-entry Refines and refreshes it, a Buff ending on the Opponent, Debuff immunity or Light interrupts of Basic Attacks pause it, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and the signature ability extends Form duration.SynergyAbomination (Immortal)Hulk (Immortal)The Green Door — This synergy extends Black Uru Form duration, entered by SP1 or starting-Form selection; re-entry Refines and refreshes it, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, signature extends its duration further, and duplicate synergies do not stack.

Crit Through BlockCritical Hits can pass through Block only in Refined Black Uru, reached by re-entry, sufficient Charge consumption via MLM or a Special at maximum Charges, or SP3 restoring the most recent Form Refined; a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and signature extends Form duration.
CrueltyPassive SP3 grants indefinite Cruelty increasing Critical Damage Rating, with additional Cruelty if a Refined Form is already active, subject to a stack cap.
Gain PowerBlocking a hit reduces the Opponent's Ability Power Rate and transfers the denied Power to Absorbing Man until he stops blocking.

Magma FormSP2 or the chosen starting Form activates Magma; re-entry Refines and refreshes it, a Buff ending on the Opponent, Debuff immunity or Light interrupts of Basic Attacks pause it, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and the signature ability extends Form duration.SynergyAbomination (Immortal)Hulk (Immortal)The Green Door — This synergy extends Magma Form duration, entered by SP2 or starting-Form selection; re-entry Refines and refreshes it, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, signature extends its duration further, and duplicate synergies do not stack.

Morph ChargeActivating a Special after the preceding attack's opening hit lands grants Morph Charges and carries that attack's bonus Critical Rating into the Special; the qualifying preceding attack and its Stun condition are unspecified.Refreshing or changing Forms grants Morph Charges based on the previous Form's remaining duration; sufficient Charges are consumed by MLM or a Special at maximum Charges to Refine the current Form and inflict temporary Vulnerability Passives.Being immune to an Armor Break or Armor Shattered Debuff grants Morph Charges; sufficient Charges are consumed by MLM or a Special at maximum Charges to Refine the current Form and inflict temporary Vulnerability Passives.

PauseOmni-Morph Forms — Interrupting the Opponent's Basic Attack with a Light Attack temporarily pauses the current Form and inflicts a temporary Vulnerability Passive, subject to a stack cap.Omni-Morph Forms — A Buff ending on the Opponent or Absorbing Man being immune to a Debuff temporarily pauses his current Form.SP3 activates the most recent Form in its Refined state and pauses it, granting Critical Rating only during that pause.SynergyBlack TarantulaPuñO Cerrado — Punishing a Special Attack with a Light Attack temporarily pauses Omni-Morph Forms through this synergy; duplicate synergies do not stack.
Pre-Fight AbilityChoose the starting Form in the Pre-Fight Menu, with Black Uru as the default; the choice persists until changed.

Refined Black Uru FormRe-enter Black Uru or consume sufficient Charges via MLM or a Special at maximum Charges to Refine it; SP3 restores the most recent Form Refined, starting-Form selection alone does not Refine, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and signature extends Form duration.SynergyAbomination (Immortal)Hulk (Immortal)The Green Door — This synergy extends Refined Black Uru duration, reached by re-entry or sufficient Charges via MLM or a Special at maximum Charges; SP3 restores the most recent Form Refined, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, signature extends duration further, and duplicate synergies do not stack.

Refined Magma FormRe-enter Magma or consume sufficient Charges via MLM or a Special at maximum Charges to Refine it; SP3 restores the most recent Form Refined, starting-Form selection alone does not Refine, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and signature extends Form duration.SynergyAbomination (Immortal)Hulk (Immortal)The Green Door — This synergy extends Refined Magma duration, reached by re-entry or sufficient Charges via MLM or a Special at maximum Charges; SP3 restores the most recent Form Refined, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, signature extends duration further, and duplicate synergies do not stack.

RegenerationPassive Signature ability: consuming Morph Charges grants temporary, non-stacking Regeneration based on missing Health, also triggered by entering or refreshing a Form as a Defender; True Damage hits pause personal Regeneration, and early Form deactivation from a Heavy hit during Special recovery removes it.

UnblockablePassive Molecular Duplication - Always Active — Special Attacks are Unblockable in a Refined Form, reached by re-entering the active Form, consuming sufficient Charges with MLM or a Special at maximum Charges, or SP3 restoring the most recent Form Refined; a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and signature extends Form duration.
Ability Power Rate ReductionBlocking a hit reduces the Opponent's Ability Power Rate until Absorbing Man stops blocking.

Armor BreakSynergyThorThor (Jane Foster)Debuff The Worthy — This synergy lets the second Medium Attack inflict temporary Armor Break on the Opponent, subject to a stack cap; duplicate synergies do not stack.
AtrophyAbsorbing Man shortens the Opponent's Indestructible, Immortality, Unstoppable and Unblockable Buffs.

Burst DamageBlack Uru attacks deal Physical Damage bursts whose Ability Accuracy cannot be modified and which benefit from Critical Damage on Critical Hits; Refined bursts can trigger through Block and be Critical, while a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate the Form subject to cooldown and signature extends its duration.Magma attacks deal Energy Damage bursts whose Ability Accuracy cannot be modified and which benefit from Critical Damage on Critical Hits; Refined bursts can be Critical, while a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate the Form subject to cooldown and signature extends its duration.SynergyThe SerpentThe Main Event — For Absorbing Man as a #Cul's Worthy recipient, this synergy strengthens Black Uru Physical bursts; Refined bursts can trigger through Block and be Critical, their Ability Accuracy cannot be modified, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate the Form subject to cooldown, and duplicate synergies do not stack.For Absorbing Man as a #Cul's Worthy recipient, this synergy strengthens Magma Energy bursts; their Ability Accuracy cannot be modified, Critical Hits enhance them, Refined bursts can be Critical, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate the Form subject to cooldown, and duplicate synergies do not stack.

Energy DamageMorph Charges — In Magma or Refined Magma Form, all attacks deal Energy instead of Physical Damage; SP2 or the starting-Form choice enters Magma, re-entry refreshes it, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and signature extends Form duration.

IncineratePassive Morph Charges — Contact with the Opponent inflicts Incinerate Passives only in Refined Magma, reached by re-entering Magma, consuming sufficient Charges with MLM or a Special at maximum Charges, or SP3 restoring the most recent Form Refined; a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and signature extends Form duration.

VulnerabilityPassive A Medium-Light-Medium combo with sufficient Morph Charges, or a Special Attack at maximum Charges, consumes available Charges to Refine the current Form and inflict temporary Vulnerability Passives based on Charges spent.Passive Omni-Morph Forms — Interrupting the Opponent's Basic Attack with a Light Attack inflicts a temporary Vulnerability Passive, subject to a stack cap, and temporarily pauses the current Form.

Ability Accuracy ModificationImmunityOmni-Morph Forms — Form changes cannot fail due to Ability Accuracy Modification; this protection applies only to Form changes.Omni-Morph Forms — Absorbing Man's personal damage bursts cannot have their Ability Accuracy modified.
Armor BreakImmunityDebuff
Armor ShatterImmunityDebuff

BleedImmunityMorph Charges — Immune to Bleed only while Black Uru or Refined Black Uru is active; SP1 or the starting-Form choice enters Black Uru, re-entry refreshes it, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and the signature ability extends its duration.

ColdsnapImmunityMorph Charges — Immune to Coldsnap only in Magma or Refined Magma Form, entered through SP2 or the starting-Form choice; re-entry refreshes it, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and the signature ability extends Form duration.

DebuffsResistanceSynergyRogueduration reduction· See source conditionsHands-On Approach — This synergy shortens Non-Damaging Debuffs on Absorbing Man, excluding Stuns; duplicate synergies do not stack.Synergy values · 7★Absorbing Man: Reduce the duration of Non-Damaging Debuffs other than Stuns by 50%.

FrostbiteImmunityMorph Charges — Immune to Frostbite only while Magma or Refined Magma is active; SP2 or the starting-Form choice enters Magma, re-entry refreshes it, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and the signature ability extends its duration.

IncinerateImmunityMorph Charges — Immune to Incinerate only while Magma or Refined Magma is active; SP2 or the starting-Form choice enters Magma, re-entry refreshes it, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and the signature ability extends its duration.
PoisonImmunitySynergyAbomination (Immortal)Hulk (Immortal)The Green Door — This synergy grants Absorbing Man Poison immunity and extends Omni-Morph Form duration; duplicate synergies do not stack.

ShockImmunityMorph Charges — Immune to Shock only in Black Uru or Refined Black Uru Form, entered through SP1 or the starting-Form choice; re-entry refreshes it, a Heavy hit during Special recovery can deactivate it subject to cooldown, and the signature ability extends Form duration.
